statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120154 (PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT can read rows despite row security policies) in 18.7 for major version 18: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120154/ lists 18.7 as the fixed release for 18, and the 18.7 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/18.7/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/a748ed909271ac58f09e3df0915adf487170a6ae on the REL_18_STABLE branch, tagged Security: CVE-2026-120154 and Backpatch-through: 14, in the REL_18_7 release tag and not in REL_18_6. It changes src/backend/executor/nodeModifyTable.c so that ExecOnConflictUpdate() checks the conflicting row against the row security policies before evaluating the ON CONFLICT WHERE clause; its other changes are regression tests. The DHI postgresql18 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql18 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/59a1f1d230675807d5a95a0c1e57ba5d640ba039/main/postgresql18/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies touch the files this fix changes, and it lists CVE-2026-120154 under its 18.7-r0 secfixes. The DHI Alpine 3.23 package repository (x86_64 and aarch64) publishes packages built from source postgresql18 at 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0, 18.6-r0 and 18.7-r0. The vulnerable code is in the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql18/postgres, which the postgresql18 package ships in every one of those builds on both architectures. We checked every published postgresql18 package for Alpine 3.23 on both x86_64 and aarch64 (checksums verified against the package index): the postgres server binary in 18.7-r0 reports PostgreSQL 18.7, while the earlier builds 18.1-r0, 18.2-r0, 18.3-r0, 18.4-r0 and 18.6-r0 report 18.1, 18.2, 18.3, 18.4 and 18.6. The fix adds no new message text, so the boundary rests on the release version that the server binary of each build reports. The earlier builds are upstream releases before 18.7, so they are affected; 18.7-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-120154, INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE letting a user read rows that row security policies should hide, in 17.12. Within major version 17, releases before 17.12 are affected. https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-120154/, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.12/. Debian fixed it for trixie in postgresql-17 17.12-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6625-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-120154. The postgres server binary in this owner's 17.12-0 build and in its rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1 reports PostgreSQL 17.12 on amd64 and arm64, so both carry the fix, and 17.12-0 is the lowest published build that does. The 17.11-1 build and the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 report PostgreSQL 17.11, and the earlier rebuilds of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1 and 17.11-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, package PostgreSQL 17.10 and 17.11. All of these are affected and sort below 17.12-0.
